definitions.explanation: Describes something that is not difficult. Written as {易|やさ}しい. Similar to {簡単|かんたん}.
Describes a person who is kind-hearted, gentle, or tender. Written as {優|やさ}しい.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{易|やさ}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{易|やさ}しい⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いてあります→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{易|やさ}しい⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me an easier problem.

examples.english: My grandmother was a kind person. She always made delicious food for me.

notes:
やさしい has two distinct meanings depending on the kanji used.

TWO MEANINGS:
1. {易|やさ}しい: easy, simple (opposite of {難|むずか}しい)
2. {優|やさ}しい: kind, gentle, tender (personality trait)

FORMS (i-adjective):
- Adverbial: やさしく
- Negative: やさしくない
- Past: やさしかった

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {易|やさ}しい{問題|もんだい}: easy problem
- {易|やさ}しい{日本語|にほんご}: easy Japanese
- {優|やさ}しい{人|ひと}: kind person
- {優|やさ}しい{声|こえ}: gentle voice

CONTRAST (meaning 1):
- {簡単|かんたん}: simple (often interchangeable)
- {難|むずか}しい: difficult (opposite)

NOTE:
When written in hiragana (やさしい), context determines the meaning.
